content.short: Paradigm is a crypto investment firm dedicated to assisting and investing in tomorrow's web3 solutions.
content.description: Paradigm backs disruptive crypto and Web3 companies and protocols with flexible check sizes ranging from $1 million to well over $100 million. Their approach is adaptable, long-term, multi-stage, and global, allowing them to participate across a wide spectrum of maturity. They often engage early in a project's formation and sustain support for portfolio companies as they grow. Their involvement is hands-on, helping teams improve at both the technical and operational levels to unlock full potential.
